metadata.title: Resume
metadata.description: Joseph Soliman is a Director/Senior Manager of Engineering with over 15 years of experience in project management, new product development, and delivering results. He has a strong background in design, implementation, production releases, continuous process improvement, and experience leading multi-disciplinary teams. Soliman's career includes engineering leadership roles at Textron Corp., Wabtec Corp., and Cummins Engine, where he delivered cost savings, reduced warranty costs and errors, and successfully launched new product families. He holds an MBA and BS in Mechanical Engineering.
